blurb: Guests can participate in self-directed or instructor-led beer tasting experiences featuring a variety of Barebottle beers and other beverages. Taprooms in Santa Clara, Menlo Park, and Walnut Creek offer rotating beers on tap, wines, kombucha, and food such as Detroit-style pizzas and empanadas. Group reservations and private event hosting are available at taprooms.
extraNote: Tipping recommended at 18% for bartenders · No open containers on patio or in taprooms; to-go beers are for to-go only · Reservations accepted for groups; wristbands and drink tickets available · Large corporate event inquiries via email events@barebottle.com · Taprooms at 2520 Augustine Dr, Santa Clara, CA; 550 B Oak Grove Ave Suite B, Menlo Park, CA; 1375 S California Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA
